Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR CGCRI) located in Kolkata, West Bengal, for filling up project-based research vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Associate - I under advertisement number 48/2627/BDPD/OLP2302/AS, offering candidates an excellent opportunity to engage in institutional research projects.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate - I post under this recruitment notification released by CSIR CGCRI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a DIPLOMA, B.E., B-TECH, BCA, or MCA degree along with specific expertise in Database Management, PPT, and EXCEL to be considered eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate - I post is 35 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, PWD, and female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 25,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply via email?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application along with necessary supporting documents via email is 13-10-2026. Applicants must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in-interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview for the shortlisted and eligible candidates has been officially scheduled to take place on 15-10-2026 at the designated institute premises.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment drive is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their soft copies of documents to the designated recruitment email address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can access the official website of the institute at www.cgcri.res.in and check the important links section of this article for direct notification details.
